import sys
import itertools

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    a = int(data[1])
    b = int(data[2])

    frames = [a] * 4 + [b] * 2
    best_answer = 6

    for perm in itertools.permutations(range(6)):
        count = 0
        leftover = 0
        for i in perm:
            if leftover < frames[i]:
                count += 1
                leftover = n
            leftover -= frames[i]
        if count < best_answer:
            best_answer = count

    print(best_answer)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()

The third line contains a single integer b (1 ≤ b ≤ n) — the length of the upper side of a door frame.
